result.reason: The addition appropriately covers professional and workmanlike performance, 90-day Site/software conformance, applicable-law compliance, malicious code, and repair/replacement/re-performance/refund remedies. However, it does not specify any warranty period for Services, so it does not clearly reach either the preferred 90-day services period or the fallback 30-day period. The Site warranty also reaches only the 90-day software fallback, not the 12-month preferred position. The change is otherwise targeted and preserves the existing provisions, though the acceptance-based trigger and the refund wording tied only to non-conforming Services could be clarified.
